name: std/memory
description: Declares owned allocations and grouped arena lifetimes.
readme: Declares owned allocations and grouped arena lifetimes.
Import this module with use memory.

files.content:
-- Declares owned allocations and grouped arena lifetimes.
public define Allocator as opaque.
public use "memory" function system() of type pointer to Allocator.
public use "memory" function arena() of type fallible pointer to Allocator.
public use "memory" function allocate(allocator of type pointer to Allocator, size of type unsigned 64) of type fallible pointer to byte.
public use "memory" function release(allocator of type pointer to Allocator, buffer of type pointer to byte) of type fallible nothing.
public use "memory" function expand(allocator of type pointer to Allocator, buffer of type pointer to byte, size of type unsigned 64) of type fallible pointer to byte.
public use "memory" function copy(allocator of type pointer to Allocator, buffer of type pointer to byte, content of type text) of type fallible nothing.
public use "memory" function view(allocator of type pointer to Allocator, buffer of type pointer to byte, size of type unsigned 64) of type fallible text.
public use "memory" function close(allocator of type pointer to Allocator) of type fallible nothing.
public use "memory" function transfer(source of type sequence of constant byte, destination of type sequence of byte) of type fallible nothing.
public use "memory" function clear(buffer of type sequence of byte) of type nothing.
public use "memory" function compare(left of type sequence of constant byte, right of type sequence of constant byte) of type integer.
